facts.text: Melanie attended a concert celebrating her daughter's birthday, which was surrounded by music, joy, and the warm summer breeze.

evidence.quote: Last night was amazing! We celebrated my daughter's birthday with a concert surrounded by music, joy and the warm summer breeze.

facts.text: Caroline attended a pride parade on Friday, which was described as having a lot of energy and love, and made her proud of the importance of standing up for equality.

evidence.quote: I went to a pride parade last Friday and it was awesome - so much energy and love everywhere. Really made me proud and reminded me how important it is to keep standing up for equality.

facts.text: Caroline described the pride parade as inspiring and mentioned that it pushed her to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.

evidence.quote: It was so inspiring, Mel! Check out the crowd. People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - it really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.

facts.text: Caroline emphasized the importance of representing inclusivity and diversity in her art and using it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community.

evidence.quote: Representing inclusivity and diversity in my art is important to me. I also use it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance.
